verdict.rationale: Mercury offers some built-in recurring automation: "automatic invoices" (mercury-docs-4), and a long-time customer mentions "auto-funding rules" on accounts (mercury-comm-1). Beyond that, recurring workflows rely on external tooling, since the API and CLI are pitched for running operations "from a script or CI pipeline" (mercury-docs-17). Webhooks are event-driven triggers, not schedules (mercury-docs-42). Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows, scheduled or recurring payments and transfers via the API, scheduling controls in the API/MCP/CLI, detailed docs on recurring invoice configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration.
